summary.text: Mayes Middleton is the Republican nominee. A Galveston oil-and-gas executive and rancher, he served in the Texas House from 2019 to 2023 and has been a state senator since 2023, chairing the Freedom Caucus. He campaigns on supporting President Trump's immigration enforcement, creating a standalone election-integrity task force and an anti-corruption team, and continuing the office's conservative litigation; the Tribune reports he has put more than $17 million of his own money into the race.

paragraphs.text: Middleton is from Galveston and holds a law degree and an undergraduate degree from the University of Texas at Austin.
He is president and CEO of Middleton Oil Company, a family business, and also runs ranching, cattle and farming operations.
Middleton served in the Texas House of Representatives from 2019 to 2022 and has been a member of the Texas Senate, representing District 11, since 2023.
The Texas Tribune describes him as a longtime Republican donor.
He is the Republican nominee for attorney general in the November 3, 2026 general election.
